title: Life and Immortal Joys Are Given
description: Life and Immortal Joys Are Given in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER NEW, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 125, headed “Faith and repentance; unbelief and impenitence”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to WINCHESTER NEW; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Life and im-mor-tal joys are given To those that mourn the sins they've done, Child-ren of wrath made heirs of heaven By faith in God's e-ter-nal Son.

lines: Life and immortal joys are given
To those that mourn the sins they've done,
Children of wrath made heirs of heaven
By faith in God's eternal Son.
Woe to the wretch that never felt
The inward pangs of pious grief,
But adds to all his crying guilt
The law condemns the rebel dead,
Under the wrath of God he lies,
He seals the curse on his own head,
And with a double vengeance dies.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to WINCHESTER NEW by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
